model.label: The Xin model (p2single v0.12, 4 cell types: alpha, beta, delta, PP): average AUC 1.000 on 321 held-out cells (random 20% of cells, not separate donors). Genes ranked by share of the model weight, each labelled with the cell type its sequences are higher in.
model.check: test_evaluation.tsv: test_n 321 (alpha 189, beta 101, delta 12, PP 19), macro_auc 1, accuracy 1, n_selected 488; run_config.json split = stratified random by sample, test_frac 0.2 (no patient column). Stage3 is_chosen yes rows: 488, all matched in multiclass_coef.tsv (key anchor|target_rank). Weight = |lasso_coef x f|; INS + SST + PPY + GCG = 81.8% of the weight. Card 6 face genes use this model (stage3_annotated_target.blast.2026-10-28.tsv.gz); 21 named genes. Known variant column: 4 sequences show "not checked" because other sequences with different bases share the same genome position, so the checked row could not be told apart.

share_note: share = gene's summed |lasso_coef x f| / summed |lasso_coef x f| over all 488 chosen sequences (no homopolymer filter)
vc_note: Known variants: sequences whose own bases differ from the genome at a known dbSNP, ClinVar or COSMIC site (variant lookups: dbSNP via Ensembl release 116, ClinVar 2026-10-25, COSMIC v104). Sequences that fit another locus as well or better are not counted. Splice junction: the sequence matches a spliced transcript better than any single piece of the genome; ties are not counted.

published.note: Every published result on the Xin dataset that the page compares with, each with its paper. The published results use their own splits (for example 5-fold cross-validation); p2single was tested on a random 20% of cells (321 cells). Same dataset, same 4 cell types, same metric.
